nom: Weleda Skin Food Original Ultra-Rich Body Cream 2.5 Fluid Ounce, Plant Rich Hydrating Moisturizer with Pansy, Chamomile and Calendula

avis.titre: New Holy Grail Nighttime Face Moisturizer
avis.texte: I have been using this as a face moisturizer at night, and it has completely transformed my skin. I live in SoCal, and the weather is in the middle of changing. Yesterday we had 5% humidity, temperature has been vacillating between the high 80s and low 50s. My skin is unbelievably dry, especially my face. As a total skincare junkie, I’ve been using two different types of moisturizer, straight Argan oil, Marine Hyaluronics by The Ordinary, and rosewater. Nothing worked. My undereyes were peeling. My foundation and concealer caught every single dry spot to the extent that I couldn’t wear makeup without looking like I had a peeling sunburn underneath. I was just about fed up when I Googled “best moisturizer for dry skin” and this came up. This is a new holy grail. The (Mild) Downsides: The smell is not phenomenal, a bit like paint, almost. It scared me at first, but I have very sensitive skin, and it hasn’t irritated it. I believe the smell is natural. I also get reactive breakouts to some products, but not this, so even though it’s thicker than acrylic paint, fear not. That brings me to my next point— this is THICK. Very, very thick, and depending on the temperature, difficult to spread. I usually just take the opportunity to massage my face, but once I get to the thin eye area I swap to a patting motion OR cut it with some Argan oil. It feels sticky but once it sinks in it really isn’t. It may be best to think of it as an overnight mask, or in very thin layers, a primer. This

avis.titre: Lovely product that I hope never changes
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product. I find it to have a pleasant, mild smell and a nice consistency. It is thick but spreads really nicely and gives kind of a sheen to the skin. It absorbs quite well on the body and face. Compared to other plant based creams I’ve used, this one is much less greasy and leaves the skin nicely moisturized without any after effects. I have discovered a specific use for it that cancels the need out for another cosmetic product, namely brow gel. I find this leaves my eyebrows softened and keeps them in place, also gives a bit of shine that is even nicer than the eyebrow gel I’ve bought from sephora. I especially like that Weleda Skin food products are gentle enough to use as an eye cream when you need that extra hydration to fight winter dryness.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: So nice. Thick and creamy with a faint clean citrus-vanilla-grass scent. Great on backs of hands and shins, feet, cheekbones and around mouth (or wherever you’re dry) in winter. Absorbs quickly for how thick it is, leaves the faintest glow. I haven’t had good results layering over other lotions, it gets sticky as a top layer. Works best for me as a stand-alone, even with the other products in line (light moisture face lotion, body lotion, and body butter). Highly recommend for dry skin.

I decided to try Weleda Skin Food because my daughter, who is 23, uses it religiously on her face. She is 23 with medium skin tone, and I am 55 with fair skin, so it doesn't necessarily seem like the same product would work for both of us. BUT, I do have pretty dry skin so I thought I'd give it a go. I apply it last, at night, after cleansing, using a nighttime moisturizer and a serum. This occlusive cream is rich, acting like a barrier. I was worried it would sticky -- it doesn't -- and that it would make me break out -- it hasn't. I don't quite look like my 23 year old daughter, BUT my skin looks (and more importantly feels) SO MUCH BETTER. Just plumper and more hydrated. It genuinely reduces the appearance of my forehead wrinkles, including my 11 lines between my eyes. I actually started using it in the winter, because I live in New England and ski a lot, my skin is subject to extreme temps. But I now use it year round and carry it with me on all my travels. It has become a staple in my routine. And let's not even talk about the price point -- so so reasonable! The only thing I don't LOVE about it is the way it smells, but it's not too strong and I can definitely live with it. I'm a huge fan.

avis.titre: I’ve known about this product for years.
avis.texte: I’ve used Weleda lip balm in the pink container for over a decade. It’s the only thing I put on my lips. But never bought Skin Food because i never needed extra oil or moisturizing (ive always had normal skin). But now, in my 50s, i became alarmed to see my facial skin becoming unusually dry. Tight dry facial skin. Very uncomfortable but also it looked awful. I suspect a body wash i started using caused this, moreso than hormonal changes. Because for over a decade I've only used a specific glycerin based bar soap. But i switched to a body wash last month and i do believe it dried my skin out badly. Anyway, it freaked me out, so i bought this and within 3 days of use my facial skin looks and feels so much better. Supple, moisturized, and luminous. Totally back to normal, if not an improvement. I am not a claiming miracles, but as for the restorative and moisturizing benefits, I have seen for myself what Skin Food can do. It works. I will always keep this on hand. One month UPDATE: Still very happy. About to order more. I use it on my face, neck, hands, and feet, daily, but will be using something else on my feet from now on, so I can stretch it out for two months at a time. Love.

Great non-irritating moisturizer for my sensitive rosacea skin. No burning when using it!! My face feels better and is way less dry, itchy and uncomfortable. No idea how this thick stuff could be used as a makeup primer it’s so thick and takes a while to soak in. I only use it at night. I love how it smells it literally relaxes me.

I have seen RAVING reviews from all over, but MUA’s in particular that made me pull the trigger on this. I will say, it absolutely makes my VERY dry and dehydrated skin look flawless with makeup. Truly, a dream. However, and the reason for only three stars, as others have said, it does have a very strong fragrance and has caused my skin to seriously hate me. I didn’t want to believe it was this product because of how good my makeup was coming out, so I started rubbing a little on my hand and dabbing my makeup brush on there just to pick some up to blend my foundation in rather than a full lather. Nope. I definitely do have super sensitive skin, so if you don’t, you’ll likely be okay. I didn’t mind the thickness because as someone with very dry skin, any moisturizing product I use feels like diaper cream 😂 I don’t mind thick, but I am genuinely nervous for how long it’ll take to repair my skin after the damage this unfortunately caused. It’s been extremely red, blotchy, and generally just irritated. I naturally have clear skin with some occasional redness every now and again. But with this… my skin is angry 24/7 at this point, with or without using it. Seems it’s been aggravated enough from using this a few times a week for about a month, so I’m hoping my clear skin returns after some barrier repair 😅

avis.titre: Life changing! No more flakey, tight skin!
avis.texte: My face is beyond dry all day every day, especially around my chin, and this product has truly changed my life. I have tried so many “ultra repair creams” and they have all been just a temporary fix. I used to have to carry around moisturizer in my purse and re-apply 3-4 times a day, but now, I don’t need to! I only use at night and apply my normal moisturizer in the AM and I stay hydrated all day long! This is definitely a product I’d only use once a day, almost like an overnight mask, since it is very thick. I’ve also seen more improvements with each day that I use it, and it’s only been a week. 10000/10 would recommend!
My wife has been asking for this months and loved it, her skin is looking better than ever.

Nachdem ich eine Allergie gegen meine alte Augencreme entwickelt hatte, musste ich zwangsläufig meine Pflegeroutine überdenken. Ich habe bereits früher schon seeeeehr viel positives über diese Creme gehört (als Gesichtscreme) und dachte mir ich gebe ihr mal eine Chance. Nachdem meine heißgeliebte Creme von Clinique aufgebraucht war, war es an der Zeit der Skin Food Creme eine Chance zu geben. Sie ist super. Anders kann ich es nicht sagen. Meine Haut ist recht verwöhnt und ich kriege von vielen "billigen" Cremes einfach ziemlich viele Pickel. Von dieser hier absolut nicht. Keinerlei Allergie, Rötungen oder ähnliches. Ich benutze sie rein als Gesichtscreme, ich kann mir aber aufgrund der Reichhaltigkeit vorstellen das sie auch gut für jegliche anderen trockenen Hautstellen geeignet ist. Meine Pflegeroutine sah und sieht im Grunde so aus das ich mich abends abschminke, wasche und dann eine reichhaltige Pflege auftrage die über Nacht einzieht. Mein Gesicht spannt sofort nach der Reinigung, ist also tendenziell sehr trocken, bis auf den obligatorischen T-Zonen-Glanz. Morgens entferne ich die nächtliche, übriggebliebene Schicht sanft mit Mizellenwasser und trage dann Primer und Makeup auf. Das war's. Eine wichtige Anmerkung auch bezüglich anderer Rezensionen hier: Die Creme zieht nicht ein. Tut mir leid aber das ist völlig utopisch. Sie ist von der Konsistenz sehr dick, ungefähr wie Bepanthen-Salbe sogar etwas dicker. Und genau so fettig. Das ist ein sehr guter Vergleich. Aber trot

I use this as a night cream, it smelled beautiful and is so nourishing without feeling greasy. I even started using it under my makeup when doing a full face makeup. Skin stays hydrated and glowy! Heard about it through Bella Hadid on IG so I had to try it. Will purchase again and again!

I love this cream; I mainly use it for my hands, but it works on dry skin wherever you need it. It is the best hand cream I have ever used and I have tried so many over the years. This one stands out as you only have to use a small amount. It is particularly good for my cuticles which can get dry & hard and no other hand cream has really helped this issue. It is thick and initially leaves your skin shiny but it soaks in and the shiny goes. It has a rather sharp smell which reminds me of eucalyptus. I'm not keen on the smell but I love the product so much I have accepted it. It's rather expensive considering the amount of product; but if it works I am prepared to pay the price. My only complaint - I wish it came in a larger tube. If you have dry hands, give this a try you won't be disappointed. I restrict it to my hands as there are other good lotions or creams for the body that are more cost effective. Although I can purchase this from my local health food stores it is cheaper on Amazon.

My face skin totally colapsed the passed winter and was super dry and just trubble. I've read about this product and the bennefits it provides. And my face is sooooo soft, looks amazing and I just love it so much. Will buy again ofc 🙏🥰💯

avis.titre: Excellent cream with an expiration date printed clearly
avis.texte: Excellent for dry skin. I purchase all my hand creams only from Weleda, which clearly prints the batch and expiration date on the package. Received a fresh hand cream with 2 years ahead before its expiration.

This is my all time holy grail skin product. As a sensitive skinned, dry af white lady this is the GOAT for believe it or not my FACE. Seems like you could clog every pore with how thick it is, but fear not it will keep your skin bouncy full protected and perfectly moisturized all day. That’s right, I use it in the MORNING under make up and everything! Then on my eyes at night along with my snail goo for the rest of my face. This cannot be beat, I want to be sponsored i stg. Buy it! Credentials in photo (unfiltered w/no base makeup)
Three boxes. Only two had product and one was empty. Not cool! The product itself is good but very oily. I only use it at night.

Weleda skin food is perfect all year! In winter months when your skin is dry and dull it revives you and makes skin appear plump again In summer it is perfect for sunburns or dry skin It’s good for a transition between seasons as well when skin is all confused if it hot or cold, humid or dry! Mine is practically gone

The tube was not sealed and has product around the outer rim suggesting it was possibly opened. Unfortunately, there's no refund. *UPDATE* I gave it a try and, maybe it's not supposed to have a foil seal. I don't know. But it smells wonderful & feels silky. I rubbed a small amount between my fingers before applying to my face and absolutely love it! It dryed into my skin with no oily residue and hours later still maintained a soft texture.

Packaging: super simple and compact but holds a lot of product! No issue dispensing. Product: very thick gel, a little goes a long way. My skin is generally normal to slightly oily in the summer so I tend to wear this mostly at night and usually as an occlusive after all my skincare routine. It not sticky and lasts a long time. I’ll go to bed and notice it still on in the morning if I sleep upright. Blends right into any skin tone without any weird cast. I LOVE USING THIS ON THE DAYS THAT I SHAVE!!! It works better than any after shave product at soothing and moisturizing. Feels great on the skin. Price: at first I thought the price was a little much but I really have heard good things about this product so I wanted to try it for myself. Considering there are 2.5 oz in this and most moisturizers are around 1 oz, very good deal in the end!! Especially with how little you have to use to over face.

So first thing I disliked about this cream was there was not a safety sticker when you open the top. I also did not like the feel of this cream its thick and feels tacky honestly it reminds me Elmers glue. I feel that you do get a decent amount but overall just did not care for this cream at all will not be buying it again.

PLEASE NEVER GET RID OF THIS!! This is my favorite Moisturizer's I’ve ever had in my whole life. I’m going on three years of using this product. I work at a beauty store and nothing beats this. It has my face hydrated and looking like glass everyday. I have really dry skin and this is the only product that works. It leaves my skin looking like glass too!! i’m a make up girly also, and this is very make up friendly !! If you’re thinking about getting it, GET IT!!

I can not believe my skin looks this good! I have very sensitive skin that flares up at the slightest hint of stress. I heard about this from a Dermatologists youtube channel and decided to give it a go. Holy s*** am I glad I did. Believe me when I say you will not recognize yourself in the morning! It was like my skin transformed overnight. It was smooth, poreless, scarring had almost disappeared and any sign of redness was gone. This was after 1 night! My co-workers mentioned I looked like I was glowing! I wash my face and apply 2 separate layers with clean hands to my face and neck. The smell is tolerable and the cream itself is extremely rich so I only wear it at night. You may feel like a greaseball but the results are worth it. I have not had a breakout since using this and, if anything, it gets rid of blemishes faster. Picture 1 (no makeup) is not my best for comparison but it shows dull, tired skin with scarring all along the side of my left face. Pictures 2 & 3 is after 3 days and the only makeup I'm wearing is mascara. Absolutely floored <3

Es una consistencia un poco pesada, hidratante y tiene un olor interesante, no es fuerte ni feo solo es peculiar, sobre todo me gusto la crema, me gusta su textura en la piel y creo que va perfecto con el maquillaje

The beauty industry is flooded with products to achieve glowing, supple, healthy, moisturized skin. I’ve spent hundreds trying to find the best, and this under $15 little gem is IT, PEOPLE. The smell has a natural Aveda-like scent which I love, and the product will make your skin look like a glowing baby angel. Fine lines reduced, acne reduced, and my most honest critic (my mother) told me my skin looks GREAT. That’s how you know it’s real. Buy this. Put it on a nice thick layer after washing your face at night, I layer M3 Vitamin C + Collagen serum underneath (also on Amazon). In the morning, clean face and apply a thin layer of Skin Food under your liquid foundation and GLOW, BABY. It’s so good. The only thing to keep in mind is that the Skin Food formula comes out THICK, so let it melt into your skin for a few seconds before blending it in. *Minnesota winter-proof *Smells like overpriced organic hipster skincare *Heavy duty moisturizing *glow lasts all day under makeup *Cheap and ships fast

avis.titre: Thick moisturizer with a great smell!
avis.texte: As a professional makeup artist, I love this product. It’s a thick, creamy consistency and smells like essential oils. It’s great for people with normal or more dry skin. I find that this product makes my skin appear very glowy and healthy. I love the way it hydrates and makes my skin shine. I use this product often on my clients and every day on myself.

avis.titre: It had been opened! Foil gone & cream in the cap
avis.texte: When I took the cap off the foil part was gone & the cream was in the cap. IT HAD BEEN OPENED!! You CAN’T send it back So I had no choice but to throw it away. I love this product!!! Soooo DISAPPOINTED!

avis.titre: New bottle is awful and lotion is greasier
avis.texte: The new aluminum bottle is awful. It is starting to tear apart and is leaking lotion. The lotion also feels different from how it felt in the previous plastic bottles. It feels greasier and thicker that it was and doesn’t absorb into my skin as well. I’m very disappointed and this lotion was the only lotion I have ever enjoyed and I got a few of my friends into it.

I love this Welda brand hand cream. I almost done with my first tube and already ordered the second one. I stumbled upon this on Amazon and so glad I tried it. Thanks to the midwest winters my hands have become so dry but this Welda hand cream has changed that. It's thick andsuper moisturizing and my hand don't feel dry. It absorbs well so your hands don't feel greasy afterwards. It gives a nice afterglow. I like the scent as well, not too overpowering . I am planning to keep one in the kitchen and one in the car. This has been a lifesaver.

avis.titre: Good for dry skin, adding extra glow, or preventing creasing from undereye makeup.
avis.texte: While the Weleda Skin Food is VERY thick (almost like cream cheese) it's a great product. I originally bought it for my mom who has dry skin however after hearing her say how great it was I decided to try it myself even though I have very oily skin. Lets just say I had to purchased my own bottle because I was using all of her product! I don't use this product all over my face since I do have very oily skin and it’s very moisturizing. A little bit under the eyes goes a long way to avoid creasing when putting concealer on. I also put a good amount under my eyes before going to bed. If you're thinking of trying this product I definitely would. A lot cheaper on amazon, saw it at Whole Foods for $20.

I think this rich cream has really strong orange smell. I like oranges so.... I think it smells good. However, I recommend only using it for feet, elbows or possibly really dry hands. It is thick and you only need a little! I had dry skin on my legs so I tried a little on them...lol it leaves a very sticky feeling. I left it on for a few hours then rinsed it off. I will say it works! Leaves skin soft and hydrated. It's okay, I wouldn't use it everyday and that's why I gave it 3 stars. If you don't want to smell like a big ripe juicy orange 🍊 this may not be the cream for you.

First of all this is an amazing moisturizer and my favorite so I was so excited when i saw it was on Amazon and on sale for prime when I received it the font of the packaging looked different I did my research and it’s fake
This was insanely greasy and it smells horrible! Think grandmotherly lol. My husband would not come near me. It feels like Vaseline. Which might be okay for some of you but for me *gags*

It's a must for harsh winters. This cream is incredibly rich so a little bit goes a long way, if you are sensitive to herbaceous botanical this scent might not be the one for you, personally I love it. The cream can leave a shine on the sink so be mindful if you don't live a very shiny face, the benefits of nourishing and skin healing properties are visible when you use this cream consistently. One of my favorites of all time.
Expensive but so worth it. I love the way it makes my skin feel. It smells good and the consistency is amazing

This is my favorite moisturizer that I use on my face at nighttime. I have really dry, sensitive skin. This cream is thick and rich and soaks into my skin all night. I have used it for about a year now and I no longer get dry patches on my nose! I love that it is made with natural ingredients. I also love the scent! It has a clean, refreshing citrus scent that is amazing. I would not recommend using this on your face during the daytime though because it is so thick and can be greasy.

If you have dry skin, this is the moisturizer for you! It has a nice, almost citrus fragrance to it. I used it on my face (normal/combination skin type) and it was super thick! I personally don't like the feeling of the product sitting on my skin and it made me break out slightly, so I only gave it 4 stars. It works great on my hands, which is typically dryer from constant washing.

avis.titre: PRODUCT IS NOT IN ENGLISH... Disappointed!!!
avis.texte: This gets a one star by force. I had high hopes for to try this, however 3 things turned me off upon receiving it and I feel others should know before purchasing. 1) It didn't come sealed in plastic wrapped 2) It didn't come with the protective aluminum seal inside where the product comes out from, Was able to squeeze product out. Wasn't to convincing it was new or not. 3) Lastly, NOTHING on this product is in English!!!! The outer box and tube itself is another language. I would not put anything on my body let alone my face that I can't read I what I'm applying on me or how to apply. Most definitely not taking any chances and will be sending it back.

Amazon had a great price on Weleda which I’ve used for a few years. Wasn’t expecting the ingredients to be listed in German, but it is the same product and works great. Weleda is manufactured in Germany, so this wasn’t a huge surprise.

I received a sample of this in an Ulta skincare kit, and fell in love FAST. My BF doesn't wear sunscreen properly no matter how often I encourage it...which means he burns often and badly. This helps not only speed up the burn to tan time, but it helps to prevent the amount of peeling/flaking if used regularly. It has a pastey/tacky texture that can be made more malleable with heat, and a little goes a loooonnngg way. See the before and after in the pictures for proof!!

I use this cream on both my face and my body when my skin needs some extra hydration. Is it a bit thick so putting it on can be hard but the results are there. This is perfect for all times of the year.
Best cream for skin. Hydrates and good moisturizer. My skin became much better it is effective. It is non sticky but good moisturizer. I almost finished and getting another one
This is simply THE BEST moisturizer for the whole body. You only need a tiny amount. Smells fantastic! Has transformed the skin on my face. Great for all skin types even sensitive skin. @weleda

I got this product for the winter since I have very dry skin. This is one of the most moisturizing products i’ve ever tried! It does leave a bit of an oily cast, but it goes away in a couple hours after the product sinks in a little more. It’s definitely heavily fragranced, but it doesn’t irritate my very sensitive/dry skin.

Its very very thick !! Not really suitable for the face and neck. I would recommend going with the light version of this cream. It’s a decent size. Smells nice. Great quality after it sooths in. But i will be returning, it was really wasn’t worth the hype. Great for under makeup.

Cheaper version of the Le Mer face cream. The tube says "body" but it can be applied to the face. Wonderful to lock in moisture for the winter but feels overly greasy which is why you only need a little bit as shown for your whole face. NOTHING helped until I used this product, and I have tried Oil of Olay, Clinique, and Argan Oil every morning. I'm very acne prone, but I have had no breakouts so far either.
I love this cream and have been using it for five years. I use it along with my other facial creams.
Doesn't run into skin well, and is greasy and leaves a tacky feel. Warning! Don't use on face! Made me breakout in pimples, but on elbows, knees, hands etc, it is very moisturizing!

I’d like someone to contact me regarding this. It is absolutely ridiculous that this cream has an expiration date that is only 5 months after the date I purchased it. If I had known this I would not have purchased.

avis.titre: You will be surprised how hungry your skin is.
avis.texte: I started using on my hands and feet which works AMAZING! I couldn't find my night cream so I grabbed skin food and put it all over my face. In the morning my face was glowing and soft. This is truly skin food and you will be surprised how hungry your skin is.
My skin is ALWAYS irritated and dry. I truly never felt like I could get it hydrated. This stuff does the trick for sure. Buy it!

Love this product but i must say i hate the new packaging they should’ve left it with the old packaging im a regular customer but the new packaging is no good and probably won’t buy again because of that
We use this for diaper rash, chapped lips, you name it. Nothing compares. It’s the best.

This moisturizer is working great! It is REALLY thick and a little goes a long way. The scent is orangey and herbal, it is not super sweet. It does leave your hands a little greasy but my hands also feel super moisturized after I use it, so I don't mind.
Highly recommended by a friend, who suggested using it before bedtime for best results. It does feel really rich, but still wasn't enough to fix my cracked fingertips.
Seal was broken so I don’t even know if the product was already used.

avis.titre: Opened, seal off, no return allowed through this site. contaminated? Manufacturer unresponsive
avis.texte: Great product, bad warehousing and shipping, someone very obviously tore into this box, removed the seal on the tube and “tested?” The product. This happens too often ordering on this site.

I buy this product often in stores and it always has a silver seal. This did not have one and thr texture is grainy and abrasive very much unlike the regular formula OR bc it lacked the seal the lotion became grainy. Not sure what happened.

avis.titre: NON REFUNDABLE!!! AWFUL!!! DO NOT PURCHASE!!!
avis.texte: I so wanted to love this product, especially since it had over 30k+ reviews. This moisturizer is incredibly greasy, to the point that I had to either pat out the oil, or try to keep spreading it all over my face hours after applying a very small amount. Not only did it not hydrate my face as evident by the flakiness of my nose & forehead as depicted, but it caused an acne flare up. See pic of my face before buying & see pic of my face after using once daily for 1 week. Smells like medicine. Amazon refuses to refund. DO NOT PURCHASE!
Great product. It’s smaller than I thought but still great. A little can be used for the entire face and affordable. It is all natural so perfect for teens
Just got it in the mail and the product has been used. Box was opened and you can see a dent in the packaging where it has been squeezed out.

avis.titre: I didn’t know my skin was so hungry..
avis.texte: I have been struggling for months with a puffy face/ sunken undereyes I think due to the weather changing dramatically every other day. It took me forever to depuff in the mornings and plump up my undereyes. I was trying everything I knew to moisturize and nourish my face, and I was STILL getting dry patches. I got this because I kept reading about it being great as a nighttime moisturizer and was recommended by many skincare professionals. I don’t know what sorcery this is (well I do because I read the label), but this stuff is incredible. My skin absolutely LOVES it and literally eats it up. The formula is thick and sticky, but absorbs well because your skin just soaks it up. I am currently applying morning and night after I my witch hazel toner and my hyaluronic acid sets in. I don’t even need an extra eye cream. My skin tone has evened out, my under eyes are plump and way less discolored/ textured, and I have a nice dewy glow. Also, I find the scent heavenly and it did not bother my very sensitive, reactive skin. I am so thankful I came across this! I had to write a review because I’ve only been using this stuff for 4 days and already seen such dramatic results!
Love this for my feet. Had a strong herbal smellso if you don't likethat them be forewarned. But it works very well so totally worth the try if you have cracked hands and heels!

This lotion is moisturizing HOWEVER it is VERY GREASY. The picture was taken 30 minutes post application after rubbing in for a solid 2 minutes. The worst thing is that while rubbing it in, which took some effort, the lotion grabs a hold of the skin which causes excessive pulling. I can only image the damage it will cause over time if applied daily. Wish I had know this before I bought it..since I used it I can’t return it. The scent is ok and it is moisturizing but at a cost of damaging to skin. Will use it on my feet

avis.titre: Watery compared to store bought one
avis.texte: I’ve used this as hand cream for 3 years. This Amazon one is watery and washes off easily. It’s not the shiny, greasy, thick consistency that stays for hours even after hand washing. Just buy it OTC. The refund process is too lengthy and costly. I noticed it has lanolin (sheep’s fat) so I’m just going to get a pound of pure lanolin for the same price. I think I’m done buying toiletries on Amazon.
Riched and nourishing thick cream with herb smell. Crema humectadora espesa y huele a hierbas.

First off, the packaging and tube information is in Swedish or German. It also doesn’t look authentic and the smell of the lotion is awful. Everything I read and the testimonials I saw of people using it said it had a very light smell. The smell is very strong and unpleasant. It’s also greasy and drying. I hate it and the sellers return policy won’t allow it to be returned even though this product is total junk.
I heard this was a beauty must have, and around for like a 100 years so I had to try it. Plus it’s cruelty-free! I love it. Great for dry winter skin.

Great lotion but terrible packaging. I received two bottles in two shipments that both had improperly sealed crimps at the top of the bottle. When you squeeze the bottle, lotion squirts out the damaged seal. Lotion is also exposed to the air. I love the feel, the scent, and the gentleness of weleda products but this product gets a thumbs down for packaging fails.
Im an MUA and I love this for my clients who want a nice natural dewy look. Smells great too!

I first tried this when someone was giving away sample sizes and thought, "Why is this stuff so thick?!" I thought no way could I use it on my face, but LOVED how it made my hands look and feel. I eventually read up on it and learned that it could be used on face and neck, so I tried it before applying makeup. I didn't like how greasy I looked. I tried it as a night cream, and it's amazing. I now only use a thin layer in the morning before applying my Laroche Posay Anthelios sunscreen serum (50 spf). My skin is sooo soft now! I like to use it on cheek bones, crows feet area, and neck. Some days I don't even bother wearing face powder or foundation. I don't look greasy, but do have a glow. It's not oily to the touch, just soft. If I'm not going for the "glow" look, I use a matte primer but wait about 15 minutes after using Skin Food before applying the primer and make up. I'm 46 with pretty nice skin to begin with, but prone to t-zone oil. Wrinkles started coming in on my forehead, crows feet area, and neck about two years ago and they have significantly decreased since using this regimen. And my face doesn't get as oily either. I now only see the crows feet when I smile, and it's much less than before.

avis.titre: From hate to love! A great cream.
avis.texte: I received this cream as a gift and to be honest at first I HATED it! I didn't like the thickness or the smell (I still am not a fan of the smell). But consider it was a gift I thought it better to keep using it since I didn't have any allergic reactions and read a little more about the various uses. As a cream for elbows and the base of feet it's probably one of the best I've used! Especially during the dry winter months in Japan it's like an amazing moisturizer for the skin. As I mentioned, I'm not a big fan of the citrusy smell. However this isn't limited to Weleda Skin Food but all products in general so it's bearable. Also, I found that if you don't mix the lotion a bit before applying it can leave a little bit of an oily residue. I don't mind it because I usually use it before sleeping but for people using it on the go it may be good to mix it a bit to make the texture even before applying. For around $9 this cream is a great deal and I would definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: Best For Intensive Overnight Cream- See my full review
avis.texte: First off, I don’t know what to think about this product. It’s more of an “experience” than a moisturizer. I went online and was looking for comparable products to Creme de La Mer. Someone’s blog recommended this as the number 2 dupe. I spent quite some time just trying to figure out what it is, or does. After my first application, my dog sniffed me for about two hours. Clearly we were both intrigued and trying to figure this out. Good? Bad? I don’t know. You decide. I’ll post what I liked and didn’t like. 1.) The Smell-has a strong smell of mineral oils with a slight residual beeswax smell and some other undertones which I can’t figure out. Overall I would say the smell is oily or medicine-y (making up words LOL). If you are sensitive to smells at all, this is not a good product for you. You’re not going to put this on and feel fresh and smell pretty. Consider this more like a therapeutic treatment. The good thing, there’s no added artificial fragrance. You are really smelling the natural ingredients, strong as they are. 2.) It’s oily/greasy. The first little bit that came out of the tube had A lot more oil around it then did the rest of the contents of the tube. Do not let this freak you out. I imagine some of the oil floats to the top of each tube. When you initially rub the product in, it is shiny and greasy from the natural oils. avis.texte: Lo usé en las líneas de marioneta, también en las bolsas debajo de los ojos, se ve una diferencia inmediata en hidratación, ayuda a que el maquillaje no se craquele. Recomiendo usar una cantidad ínfima de producto hasta acostumbrarse a la textura. Es una crema muy pesada. Incredible! My skin was extremely dry and ashy, even scratching it would leave white marks. After using this every other day for just two weeks, my skin looks so much better, hydrated, and glowing!

I have been using this as my facial moisturizer for over five years now, the only other product that I will use on my face is beef tall. I have found that the more natural options I use with less chemicals and harsh ingredients, the better my face is. Does not clog pours and a little goes a long way! I have bought this for family members and recommend it to anyone that is looking for a new moisturizer. You cannot beat what this does for your skin plus it being plant-based.
